title: Canonical sequence-site operations and the left-adjoint tensor square
statement: For a prime l and finite coefficient field E, on the strict system categories of def-sf-integral-system-operations, there are Operations o, Compositors c, OpenComparisons a and CanonicalBridge b (def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge), together with ProperOpenCoherence (def-sf-integral-system-realization-data). For every commutative scheme square, the specified pullback tensor comparisons commute with c.square: square on the tensor, followed by the two tensor comparisons, equals the other two tensor comparisons followed by tensor of the square on the two factors. This is an equality of left-adjoint transformations, before right-adjoint exchange or projection is formed. There is no integral reduction/limit or completed ringed model assertion.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument, as recorded in lem-sf-integral-canonical-ambient-models.

proof.text: Obtain o,c and the normalized open comparisons a and section bridge b from integralSystemOperationModels. This uses only the ordinary/derived construction assertion, with neither proper/open coherence nor the tensor square supplied.
Apply integralSystemProperOpenTransport to these same o,c,a,b to obtain ProperOpenCoherence.

For a commutative square, cancel the invertible c.pullComp(r,i) on the tensor at the source. Expand c.square as inverse compositor, equality transport and compositor. Apply integralSystemTensorComposition on each length-two path. Equality induction gives compatibility of the tensor comparison with the scheme-map equality transport. Functoriality of the tensor bifunctor combines its maps, and the inverse compositor cancels on each tensor factor. This proves the stated square equation on the whole derived system category. The cancellation calculation and equality induction are proved as private lemmas for an abstract tensor bifunctor and morphisms in one category, then instantiated with the fixed system models to avoid unfolding their construction. For kernel efficiency, square_eq identifies the natural isomorphism before square_hom_app takes its components by congruence; the generic trans_hom_app supplies the component formula without reducing the coefficient construction.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence, strict-system realization. D6: derive the square from tensor composition on its two paths and equality transport; ordinary model construction and intrinsic proper/open transport are separate obligations.

theorem integralCanonicalSystemCoherence :
    ∃ (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
      (a : OpenComparisons l E o c) (b : CanonicalBridge l E o),
      Nonempty (ProperOpenCoherence l E o c a b) ∧
      ∀ {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}}
        (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W) (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z)
        (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (A B : System l E Z),
        (c.square l E k r p i h).hom.app ((calculus l E Z).systemClosed.tensor.obj (A, B)) ≫
            (pull l E k).map ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E p).hom.app (A, B)) ≫
            (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E k).hom.app
              ((pull l E p).obj A, (pull l E p).obj B) =
          (pull l E r).map ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E i).hom.app (A, B)) ≫
            (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E r).hom.app
              ((pull l E i).obj A, (pull l E i).obj B) ≫
            (calculus l E U).systemClosed.tensor.map
              (Prod.mkHom ((c.square l E k r p i h).hom.app A)
                ((c.square l E k r p i h).hom.app B))
